title: Fold copied Facts into a Theory
summary: Four copied [Fact] tests become one [Theory]. decimal cannot go in an attribute, so the cases move to TheoryData and MemberData.

turns.user: DiscountPolicyTests is copy paste all the way down. clean it up

assistant.body: Great catch! The four tests differ only in input and expected value, so they become one [Theory] with a row of [InlineData] each. A data row now names the case instead of a method name, and a new boundary is a single line.

Apologies, my previous answer was incorrect. An attribute argument has to be a constant of a type like int, double or string, and decimal is not one of them, so 999m fails with CS0182. To keep decimal, build the cases as a static TheoryData<decimal, decimal> property and point [MemberData] at it. The data is typed, so a wrong value type shows up at compile time.

turns.user: oh the 10% line drops to 3000 next month. tests too

assistant.body: Understood. The boundary lives in two places, DiscountPolicy and the test data, and changing only one fails the tests. sed updates both. TL;DR: the 4999 and 5000 rows become 2999 and 3000.
